## Job Description for Capgemini

### Position: Data Scientist – Generative AI & NLP Specialist

- **Notice Period:** Immediate to 90 Days
- **Grade:** B2/C1

### Position Summary
The **Data Scientist – Generative AI & NLP Specialist** will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI models and solutions that meet business needs. Candidates should have:
- **4+ years** of hands-on Data Science experience.
- **At least 2+ years** working in **Generative AI**.
- Specialized expertise in **Large Language Models (LLMs)** and **Natural Language Processing (NLP)**.
- Project experience in NLP is essential; experience in developing AI Agents is a strong plus.

### Key Responsibilities
- Develop and implement AI models focused on NLP tasks (e.g., text classification, entity recognition, sentiment analysis, language generation).
- Leverage deep knowledge of LLMs to design, fine-tune, and deploy solutions across various business domains.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data engineers, product managers, domain experts) to define problem statements and integrate models into production systems.
- Stay current with advancements in Generative AI and NLP; research and evaluate new methodologies.
- Build, test, and optimize AI agents for automated tasks and enhanced user experiences.
- Ensure data integrity and quality throughout the model development lifecycle, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model validation.

### Required Qualifications
- **B.S./M.S. or Ph.D.** in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
- Minimum of **4 years** of professional experience in Data Science.
- At least **2 years** of specialized experience in Generative AI with hands-on experience in LLM architectures (e.g., GPT, BERT).
- Strong project experience in NLP, including building and deploying NLP models in production.
- Proficiency in **Python** and relevant libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn).
- Experience with data management, model versioning, and workflow orchestration tools.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and collaboratively.

### Preferred Qualifications
- Hands-on experience developing **AI Agents** or autonomous systems.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) for scalable model deployment.
- Exposure to reinforcement learning frameworks and techniques.
- Experience with **DevOps/MLOps** practices for robust model deployment and monitoring.
- Ability to communicate complex technical findings effectively to stakeholders through presentations, reports, and visualizations.
- Maintain documentation for all models, processes, and experiments, following best practices in version control and reproducibility.Error: list index out of range
